title: CS2 invigilated programming tests
summary: Students complete two invigilated CS2 programming tests by implementing functions in CodeRunner. Codex was evaluated offline against the same prompts and grading scheme, showing the assessments' susceptibility to AI-generated code while student AI use in the tests was not permitted by the invigilated setting.

sources.title: My AI Wants to Know if This Will Be on the Exam: Testing OpenAI’s Codex on CS2 Programming Exercises

grading.method: CodeRunner used all-or-nothing correctness and repeated-attempt penalties up to 50%.
